description: This file defines a React functional component 'TeamSSOSettings' that manages and renders team Single Sign-On (SSO) settings, allowing viewing and editing of settings fetched from backend APIs. It includes state management, API calls, form rendering, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: fetchTeamSSOSettings
methods.description: Asynchronous function fetching team SSO settings and available models from backend APIs, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Handles saving updated settings to the backend and updates component state upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleTextInputChange
methods.description: Updates the editedValues state when user modifies input fields.

methods.name: renderEditableField
methods.description: Renders appropriate input components based on the property schema for each setting key.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Displays the value of a setting in a human-readable format when not editing.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Dynamically renders all the setting fields based on schema, supporting both view and edit modes.
